title: Caesar shift
description: The first line is a shift K (0 to 25); the second is text in lowercase letters and spaces. Move every letter K places forward in the alphabet, wrapping from z back to a, and keep spaces as they are.
buggyCode:
k = int(input())
text = input()
out = ""
for ch in text:
    out += chr(ord(ch) + k)
print(out)
